prompt: InnovateCo, a tech company, began the year with 100 software developers. In Q1, 15% of their developers left the company. Immediately after, InnovateCo hired 20 new software developers. The company then assigned all current developers to new projects, maintaining a strict ratio of 3 Frontend developers for every 2 Backend developers. Each Frontend developer works 160 hours per month, and each Backend developer works 180 hours per month. The company budgets $75 per hour for Frontend development and $85 per hour for Backend development. What is the total combined monthly cost, in dollars, for all software development efforts at InnovateCo?
